method_descriptions.pace: Full PaCE: Tchebycheff + cross-direction LOO + frontier shaping + coverage bandit
method_descriptions.pace_uniform: PaCE with uniform direction sampling (ablates the coverage bandit)
method_descriptions.pace_no_front: PaCE with lambda_front=0 (ablates dominance + crowding shaping)
method_descriptions.cond_linear: Homogeneous groups, weighted-sum advantage (conditioned GRPO as usually applied)
method_descriptions.cond_mognorm: Homogeneous groups, MO-GRPO-style per-objective z-score then sum
method_descriptions.fixed_scalar: N independent runs at fixed weights, equal total budget (status quo)
